sentences.text: Hoplitosuchus is a genus of archosaur belonging to the order Aetosauria, which falls within the unranked group Crurotarsi and the infraclass Archosauromorpha.
Scientists currently do not consider Hoplitosuchus a valid genus because its defining specimen consists of unidentifiable armor plates.
Material once attributed to this animal was later used to name the dinosaur Teyuwasu, now recognized as Staurikosaurus.
The name was originally Hoplitosaurus in 1902, but von Huene renamed it Hoplitosuchus in 1938 after discovering the first name was already taken by a dinosaur.
Fossils were discovered in the Santa Maria Formation of Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil.
This creature lived during the Carnian and Norian stages, spanning from 237 to 205.7 million years ago.
While Hoplitosuchus raui is the only known species, the holotype is considered a nomen dubium due to its unidentifiable osteoderms and potential mix of rauisuchian and dinosaurian remains.
